test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We shall rehearse thrice before the final performance __at least we make errors__ in the dialogues.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase lest means **"to avoid the risk of" **or **"for fear that,"** making it the** correct choice** in this context.
 
• The correct statement should read **"We shall rehearse thrice before the final performance lest__ we make errors in the dialogues." ** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not fit the contextually correct intention of preventing errors:
 
 
• **Can we make errors:** This does not fit logically or grammatically.
 
• **But we make errors:** This indicates a contrast, not prevention of errors.
 
• **For we make errors:** This indicates a reason, not prevention.
